title: Installation and Configuration Guide
key_sentences: Tessellate Gateway is a reverse proxy that routes API requests from client applications to internal services.
This guide describes a single-node installation; clustered deployments are covered in a separate document.
The service needs no elevated privileges once the listening port is above 1024 or the capability to bind low ports has been granted.
Changes to the upstream list can be applied without a restart by sending the reload signal, whereas changes to the listening address always require a restart.

rows: Separate interfaces for clients and services
Address and port on which client connections are accepted.
Worker threads handling requests; values above twice the number of cores rarely help.
Time allowed for an upstream service to send the first byte of its response.
One of debug, info, warn or error.
Use json when the log is collected by an aggregation system.
Check the path given with the --config option.
Certificate and key do not match
Regenerate the key pair or correct the file paths.
Verify the address and the firewall rules between the gateway and the service.

list_items.text: A user account with sudo rights on the target server
Outbound HTTPS access to the download server, or the archive copied by hand
A TLS certificate and private key for the public host name
Create a dedicated system user and group for the service.
Download the release archive and verify its checksum.
The checksum file is published next to each archive.
Stop if the verification reports a mismatch.
Unpack the archive under /opt and create a version-independent link.
Copy the example configuration file and adapt it as described in section 4.

code:
sudo groupadd --system tessellate
sudo useradd --system --gid tessellate --home-dir /var/lib/tessellate tessellate
curl -fsSLO https://dl.tessellate.example/gw/3.4.2/tgw-3.4.2-linux-amd64.tar.gz
sha256sum -c tgw-3.4.2.sha256
sudo tar -xzf tgw-3.4.2-linux-amd64.tar.gz -C /opt
sudo ln -s /opt/tgw-3.4.2 /opt/tessellate

# /etc/tessellate/gateway.yaml
server:
  listen: 0.0.0.0:8443
  workers: 4
  tls:
    certificate: /etc/tessellate/tls/gateway.crt
    private_key: /etc/tessellate/tls/gateway.key
upstreams:
  - name: billing
    url: http://10.20.0.15:9000
    timeout_ms: 2500
  - name: inventory
    url: http://10.20.0.22:9100
    timeout_ms: 4000
logging:
  level: info
  format: json

[Unit]
Description=Tessellate Gateway
After=network-online.target

[Service]
User=tessellate
ExecStart=/opt/tessellate/bin/tgw --config /etc/tessellate/gateway.yaml
Restart=on-failure
LimitNOFILE=65536

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
